notes.title: Train Sim World 4 Game Update – Suspension & Formation
notes.notes:
Today, we have a large core update to Train Sim World 4 that brings new suspension physics to a range of locomotives, formation designer is also joining the Creators Club and losing the beta tag, and finally we have some additional improvements and fixes to enhance your experience. Read on for a full list of changes.

[b]What is Suspension?[/b]

In our July roadmap, we announced that the long-awaited Suspension improvements coming to Train Sim World 4 will be included in our Summer Core updates, and since then our development teams have been working hard to implement and test the suspension feature.

Currently in Train Sim World, you experience motion as you drive the train along the tracks, with noticeable left, right, and backward movements as the train accelerates, decelerates, or goes around corners. However, something that we wanted to improve is the ‘up and down’ motion of the train as it goes over lifts or junctions. With this update, the suspension will be significantly improved to allow for a more realistic feel of the train moving over the tracks; the wheels will dip into junctions and players can get a feel of the cab rocking up and down, as they ride over junction joints.

With this update, the improved suspension update will be added to the below locos:

[list]
[*] [url=https://youtu.be/n9uwAjzKzrg]ECML – Class 801 Azuma[/url]
[*] [url=https://youtu.be/fyOySZ8Nz4Y]ECML – Class 66[/url]
[*] ECML – FKA Wagons
[*] Vorarlberg – ÖBB 4024
[*] Vorarlberg – Habbins, Kjils, Laeers
[*] Maintalbahn – BR 624
[*] Maintalbahn – Eanos, Habbiins, Roos-t
[*] [url=https://youtu.be/1cRLBGNrrzE]Rosenheim – BR 185.2[/url]
[*] [url=https://youtu.be/f317jZkLHFc]Rosenheim – ÖBB 4024[/url]
[*] Rosenheim – Habbiins, Doppelstock
[*] Semmeringbahn – ÖBB 4024
[*] Semmeringbahn – Habbiins, U708
[*] Flying Scotsman Mk1 and Mk2 coaches
[*] [url=https://youtu.be/wnv41MWh9Tk]Blackpool Branches – Class 08[/url]
[*] [url=https://youtu.be/wnv41MWh9Tk]Blackpool Branches – Class 47[/url]
[*] Scotrail BR Class 380
[*] [url=https://youtu.be/X0Yi_WBCyWg]Training Centre – Class 323[/url]
[/list]

The new suspension system will be integrated as a standard feature in future add-ons. We will also keep exploring ways to implement this system in more locomotives from our existing catalogue whenever possible, including trains from the Antelope Line and LIRR Commuter. 

[h3][b]Formation Designer[/b][/h3]

Formation Designer is also making its way to Creators Club in this update, allowing compatibility to share your creations to the community, and download other submitted formations, amongst other improvements to help the new feature work as smoothly as possible. 

Alongside this update, we're also removing the Beta tag, as we've completed all the four phases we set out when implementing Formation Designer initially. Of course, we will continue to improve and update the system moving forward in future patches.

This update should be available on all platforms from 13:00 UTC / 14:00 BST, please allow up to 24 hours for updates to come through.

notes.title: Winter Core Update - February
notes.notes:
Hello folks, and welcome to February. 
The days are getting longer, spring is around the corner, and – perhaps most excitingly of all – we have a wide range of improvements and quality of life changes releasing today as part of a large core update, which includes an Open Beta for Formation Designer for Steam players. 
You can expect to see improvements for Blackpool Branches, Maintalbahn, Centro Regional Railway Class 323, and many more!

Get a cup of your favourite beverage, because this is a long read.


[h1]Core [/h1]

[list]
[*] Mods created for Add-ons now work in the same way that Core mods do.   
[*] General improvement to brightness on PIS screens to be more visible/readable during both day and night. 
[*] Fixed an issue where service names would extend outside of the Debriefing UI screens 
[*] Fixed an issue where medals for completed Timetables, Scenarios, and Training modules didn’t display correctly on the main menu. 
[*] Fixes to Journey Mode continue option so that the option is consistently offered and works as intended. 
[*] Fixed a crash with Xbox S/X on Scenario Planner with multiple add-ons installed 
[*] Resuming a saved game using Classic Controls will no longer lock the screen. 
[*] Minor memory performance improvements.  
[*] Minor core performance improvements to slightly improve boot time and maintain stability, especially when in large freight yards and on larger routes. 
[*] Various NPC passenger model improvements and fixes. 
[*] Various localisation changes. 
[/list]

[h3]Minimal HUD [/h3]

[/list]

[*] Fixed various issues with camera collisions when orbiting. 
[/list]

[h3]Free Roam [/h3]

[list]

[*] Fixed an issue preventing the MRCE and Dispolok 182 from moving. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the DB BR 185.5 wouldn’t move after spawning. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Class 47 and 52 wouldn’t take power after spawning. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the BR 146 wouldn’t take power after spawning.

[*] Fixed an issue where the speeding penalty was not being correctly applied.

[h1]Blackpool Branches [/h1]

[*] Passengers no longer appear at Lichfield Trent Valley in the scenario "Engineering a Shunt", as this station has engineering work going on.

[*] Made the Class 31 drivable on the 3-coach-consist and the Mineral wagons on freight services 
[*] Fixed Numbering so each class 142 livery displays correct numbers for the era 
[*] Fixed an issue where Service 2J52 would cause a derailment upon launch.
[/list] 

[h3]Class 142 [/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with AI getting stuck trying to open doors

[/list]

[h3]Class 47 [/h3]

[list]
[*] Changed font on vehicle numbering to the correct type 
[*] Fixed an issue on the Class 47 service 0Z25 where the player spawns at a faraway station 
[/list]

 

[h1]Midland Main Line [/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed various spelling mistakes on signage and in text. 
[*] Reduced number of high-rise buildings around Loughborough, Long Eaton and Derby stations to better represent the area. 
[*] Removed a signal box from a yard behind Spondon station.

[h3]Class 158 [/h3]

[list]

[/list]



[h1]Bernina Line [/h1]

(Valleys will have less dense fog, hills will have more dense fog)

[h1]Birmingham Cross City [/h1]

[h3]WMR Class 323 [/h3]

[h3]EWS Class 66 [/h3]

[*] Fixed an issue with headlight emissions. 
[*] Fixed a texture issue on the PTS. 
[*] In Livery Editor, artefacts no longer appear when using decals and a green trim around. windows no longer appears. 
[/list]

 

[h1]Antelope Valley [/h1]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where cars/vehicles can drive through trains on multiple crossings instead of stopping between Lancaster and Palmdale. 
[*] Fixed an issue across multiple services where players couldn’t achieve Platinum medals
[/list] 

[h3]Metrolink Rotem cars  [/h3]

[list]
[*] Will now correctly use air as appropriate 
[*] Fixed an issue with the brake application audio hiss not playing 
[*] Doors should correctly operate down the entire consist when paired with Bi Level cars

[*] Fixed a texture issue causing some buses to have vibrant emissive windows

[*] Parking brake buttons will now correctly apply the brakes.

notes.title: Winter Core Update (Part 1) - Update Notes
notes.notes:
This is the first part of our Winter Core Update, which includes new features and improvements for the Minimal HUD, Core fixes and various improvements to East Coast Main Line, Vorarlberg, Birmingham Cross City and a large list of changes from Skyhook Games coming to Midland Main Line, which you can view in full on their [url=https://skyhookgames.com/train-sim-world-midland-main-line-december-update/][b]Midland Main Line update page[/b][/url], based on the community feedback submitted by all of you.

The second part will include the Formation Designer, Suspension features as well as additional core improvements. We don't have an ETA on this, but you can expect us to talk more about the delivery for this update when we return in the new year.

[b]Core[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Vorarlberg BR185 from moving in free roam
[*] Fixed a rare condition causing players to end up underneath the map when cycling through the passenger camera views.

Class 801 Azuma

ÖBB 4024

[*] Increased visibility of cab indicator lights during the daytime.
[*] Fixed an issue where acknowledging SIFA was inconsistent.

[b]Maintalbahn[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Stopping boards in Miltenberg having text that reads "Hidden in Game".

West Midlands Railway Class 323

notes.title: Train Sim World Update Notes - 31st October
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[i][b]We've only got treats for you tonight[/b][/i], as we're going live with the following changes!
[i]These improvements should be working their way to you over the next 24 hours.[/i]

We're still continuing to take on your feedback, and this is the third of our post-release patch updates coming your way.

[h3][b]Patch Highlights[/b][/h3]
[b]Core[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the front-facing external camera bouncing uncontrollably when moving through tunnels or under bridges.
[*] Fixed an issue where mastery challenge bars failed to update progress
[*] Fixed an issue preventing PS5 trophies from being unlockable
[/list]

[b]East Coast Mainline[/b]
[list]
[*] Class 801 Azuma 
[*] Decals can now be placed on the far ends of coaches in Livery Designer.
[*] Increased volume of the DVD alarm.
[*] Enabled Gamepad interaction with AWS control.
[/list]

[b]Flying Scotsman[/b]
[list]
[*] Enabled Gamepad interaction with AWS control.
[*] AWS Warning / Clear sounds can now play out the PlayStation controller speaker.
[/list]

[b]Vectron[/b]
[list]
[*] Adjustments to the starting brake modes.
[*] Improvements to cab lighting and functionality.
[*] A wide range of various improvements and fixes.
[/list]

[b]Antelope Valley[/b]
[list]
[*] Upstairs seats will now count toward the ‘Take a Seat’ objective in the Introduction.
[/list]

[b]Additional[/b]
[list]
[*] Modded .pak files should now work as expected within Train Sim World 4.
[/list]

[h3][b]Full Changelog[/b][/h3]
[b]Core[/b]
[list]
[*] Main Menu music will now be on by default.
[*] Reduced time opening route selection menu with many add-ons installed.
[*] Fixed issue whereby it was possible to duplicate timetable menus via the search bar.
[*] Fixed an issue where mastery challenge bars failed to update progress on ECML and Vorarlberg.
[*] Fixed an issue with the front-facing external camera bouncing uncontrollably when moving through tunnels or under bridges.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing PS5 trophies from being unlockable
[*] Modded .pak files should now work as expected within Train Sim World 4.
[/list]
Free Roam
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash in Free Roam when attempting to delete a moving AI loco.
[*] Fixed an issue in Free Roam where the player would fall out of the world when removing a loco they are seated on.
[/list]
Photo Mode
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where horn input was being triggered when accessing Photo Mode with the ‘Shift + Space’ shortcut.
[*] Added ‘Shift + Space’ to the keyboard layout menu.
[/list]

[b]East Coast Mainline[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved water visuals across the route.
[*] Improved landscape and track materials with greater normal map definition.
[/list]
Class 801 Azuma
[list]
[*] Decals can now be placed on far ends of coaches in Livery Designer.
[*] Increased source volume of the DVD alarm.
[*] Increased the controller volume multiplier to improve controller audio clarity.
[/list]

[b]Antelope Valley[/b]
[list]
[*] Upstairs seats will now count to the ‘Take a Seat’ objective on the Introduction.
[*] Improved water visuals across the route.
[*] Improved landscape and track materials with greater normal map definition.
[/list]
EMD F125
[list]
[*] Added exterior Alerter audio
[/list]
Rotem Cab Cars
[list]
[*] Added the External Alerts functionality to the Rotem cab cars so that it can be heard on the outside of the train
[/list]

[b]Vorarlberg[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved track wetness visuals.
[*] Improved landscape and track materials with greater normal map definition.
[/list]
ÖBB 4024
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with horn audio getting stuck when both horn buttons are used too quickly
[*] Passenger doors can no longer be opened whilst moving
[/list]

[b]Vectron[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Adjustments to the starting brake modes.[/b]
[i]The Vectron should now start in brake mode "G" if the train weight exceeds 800t, otherwise "P" if the formation has freight wagons or "R" if the train is a single locomotive or only has passenger wagons. The PZB Mode will only switch between "O" (same conditions as "R" brake) or "M" (otherwise).[/i]
[*] [b]Various improvements to cab lighting.[/b]
[i]Added a second spotlight component that illuminates the air condition panel.
Corrected the behaviour of the reading light and cab light. Reading light requires the battery to turn on, the cab light illuminates regardless of battery state.
Increased the brightness of the cab and reading lights.
Disabled input to the Reading Light fuse (to match real life input)[/i]
[*] Added PZB reverse status message
[*] Added missing "Schnellbr. durch Seitenfahrschalter" CCD message
[*] [b]Implemented country dependent “Quick Release” behaviour.[/b]
[i]In Germany, the Quick Release only fills the brake pipe to 5.0 bar and does not manually overcharge the brake pipe (automatic overcharge is still active and boosts the EQ/BP to 5.2 bar).
In other countries, Quick Release will allow the BP to rise to 5.8 bar and holding the lever in this position also overcharges the EQ/BP up to 5.8 bar.[/i]
[*] [b]Range of improvements to Vectron functionality and logic[/b]
[i]Changed Electric Brake Valve logic to be absolute (standard/old behaviour) in Germany and relative in other countries.
Implemented logic to force the Train Brake lever to skip step 1A if going from “Running” to a higher step.
Fixed an issue with the "1A-1B notch logic" of the train brake lever that sometimes made the train brake jump back to 1B when releasing into 1A, if the train brake had been moved to notch 2 or higher previously without stopping in 1A or 1B.
Changed the behaviour of the Train Length Counter to turn off the function after 5 minutes of the train being stationary.[/i]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the train length remaining number to get stuck if the train stopped before it had run out.
[*] Fixed the Horn High/Low fuses to be up when closed and down when open.
[*] Fixed the Horn fuse labels that made the label always state "Open".
[*] Fixed the Ebula Time and Date display
[*] Fixed an issue in the TDD Overview page that made the total tractive effort number have a minus sign even when zero, if recently braking.
[*] Fixed PZB mode always showing 55 after switching from reverse to neutral/forward till reconstruct
[*] Fixed an issue with the road runner display.
[*] Fixed an issue where AFB would not flash on AFB activation
[*] GSMR beep will now sound upon cab activation rather than moving the Reverser to Forward.
[*] Fixed an issue where AFB would not sound when moving the Reverser to Neutral.
[*] Changed BSAAS Battery State to use the actual Battery state rather than Supply Voltage.
[*] Implemented a trigger that sounds the ZBF alert when moving the reverser to Forward with PZB enabled.
[*] Fixed an issue that made the transformer audio cut out when the MCB is opened and then closed above 40 km/h.
[*] Fixed an issue that made it possible to change the PZB mode in the MFD settings page while the locomotive is running or PZB is in restrictive mode.
[/list]

[b]Flying Scotsman[/b]
[list]
[*] Enabled Gamepad interaction with AWS control.
[*] AWS Warning and AWS Clear sounds can now play out of the PlayStation controller speaker.
[*] Resolved issue with the AWS whereby going over a clear magnet would play the Warning end sound.
[*] Alarms can now be heard both in and outside the cab
[*] Implemented new Scotsman Chuffs from mainline recordings.
[/list]

[b]Cajon Pass[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed branding for “Snapple” on the hotdog cart collectable.
[/list]

[b]Luzern-Sursee[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue resulting in a crash on Luzern’s “Unexpected Express” scenario.
[/list]

[b]Great Western Express[/b]
[list]
[*] Raised HST Drivers Seat camera by 10cm following community feedback.
[/list]

[b]Dispolok 182[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated sounds and logic for horns.
[*] Updated traction motor implementation and sounds

notes.title: PC Editor (Beta) And NEC: New York – Trenton Timetable Update
notes.notes:
Hello folks,

[i]Tomorrow is the big day![/i] Not only is Train Sim World 4 released, but with it comes a slew of additional updates to some of your favourite content. Full details will be provided in tomorrow’s update notes, but we know you’re champing at the bit to know about, in particular the status of the PC Editor (Beta) and Trenton Timetable update.

[h2][b]PC Editor (Beta)[/b][/h2]

First thing’s first: we're pleased to say, [b]The Train Sim World PC Editor (Beta) will launch tomorrow[/b], with the full launch of Train Sim World 4. It will be available from the Epic Store – searching ‘Train Sim World PC Editor’ should take you to the download page.

We’ll be doing some live streamed masterclasses on how to get the best out of the tool over the coming weeks, but we can’t wait for you to try it out for yourself, with the tools our team use. Please check out the [url=https://dovetailgames.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/80001086985-train-sim-world-4-faq#What-is-the-Advanced-PC-Editor?][b]Editor FAQs[/b][/url] – and make sure you’re sharing your tips, tricks, and questions to our [url=https://forums.dovetailgames.com/forums/pc-editor-discussion/][b]dedicated Editor forum[/b][/url].

As a final note, the Editor is in a beta format, and therefore liable to changes and amendments. We recommend that, whilst we’re working with you on building and amending the tool that you try out its various functionalities and let us know your thoughts – larger-scale projects (ie. Route-building) are something we’d recommend when the tool is a little further progressed.

[h2][b]NEC: New York – Trenton New Timetable[/b][/h2]

The team have been doing a great job of updating the Trenton timetable – which will be released tomorrow, with the game mega-update.

The updated timetable sees:
[list]
[*] (many) more NJT playable and AI services
[*] Long Island Rail Road AI layer added
[*] Amtrak AI services added
[/list]
Adding around [b]FIVE TIMES[/b] the services from the original timetable (just over 2,000 playable and AI services).

Players can choose the new timetable, or the existing Train Sim World 3 timetable ('reduced' timetable). For best performance, we strongly recommend that if you are on the following platforms, you select the following timetables:
[list]
[*] [b]PS4/Xbox One/Xbox Series S[/b] – use the original TSW3 timetable (reduced timetable)
[*] [b]PS5/Xbox Series X/PC[/b] - use the updated timetable
[/list]
Depending on your hardware, you may choose to play on the reduced timetable, if you’re struggling with performance – as in certain locations, it can be very demanding on your system.

[url=https://forums.dovetailgames.com/threads/train-sim-world-4-%E2%80%93-what-you-need-to-know.73462/][b]As mentioned last week[/b][/url], we have had to manage content with performance, so AI freight will not be part of the launch build for all players.

Progress is NOT shared between the normal and reduced Trenton timetables, as the experience is so different. Your existing progress should map onto the reduced timetable.

[h2][b]East Coast Main Line Patch[/b][/h2]

In case you missed it, we’ve launched our first post-release content patch, focusing on East Coast Main Line – in particular, AWS alarm volume, Azuma audio tweaks, and Azuma PIS tweaks.

We’ve also provided a reduced timetable for Gen-8 players, for when compatible content layers become available, in the same format as above.

[url=https://forums.dovetailgames.com/threads/east-coast-main-line-patch-timetable-update.73938/][b]View the full ECML change log.[/b][/url]

[h2][b]Compatible content[/b][/h2]

We expect all compatible content to start rolling out from launch time (15:00 UTC consoles, 17:00 UTC PC), but it may take a little while for it all to roll out. We can’t wait to see what chaos you can create with Free Roam Mode, and also the layers launching to enhance your experience of the core TSW4 routes.

Thank you for all of your feedback and amazing screenshots so far, we've really enjoyed reading and seeing them. Roll on tomorrow!

notes.title: East Coast Main Line: Azuma Audio/PIS Improvements & ECML Timetable Update

Thank you to all for the feedback during the early access period of Train Sim World 4, our teams have been working hard to deliver the best experience over this time, and today we’re sharing a set of audio improvements to the Class 801 Azuma on East Coast Main Line.
[i]These improvements should now be live on all platforms[/i]

[list]

[/list]
[b]BR Class 801 Azuma[/b]
